sentences.text: Day 9 Deep Cleaning Once a week, I like to deep clean my house.
If I don't use it, it's got to go.
I go through closets, drawers, and random junk that somehow piles up.
sentences.text_ko: 옷장이나 서랍, 여기저기 쌓인 잡동사니를 다 훑어봐요.

sentences.text: Once I've cleared the clutter, I wipe down all surfaces, dust the shelves, and vacuum every corner of my house.
sentences.text_ko: 정리 끝나면 모든 표면을 닦고, 선반 먼지 털고, 집 구석구석 청소기를 돌려요.

sentences.text: I make sure to get the hard to reach spots I usually ignore, like behind the couch.
sentences.text_ko: 평소에 잘 안 닦는 소파 뒤 같은 곳도 꼭 챙겨요.

sentences.text: I also do the dishes, wipe down appliances, and clean out the fridge.
sentences.text_ko: 설거지도 하고, 가전도 닦고, 냉장고 정리도 해요.

sentences.text: Then, I grab my broom and dustpan to sweep the floor and pick up any dust or crumbs before I mop.
sentences.text_ko: 그다음엔 바닥을 쓸고 물걸레질하기 전에 먼지랑 부스러기를 정리해요.

sentences.text: Next, I do a load of laundry.
I sort my clothes and throw them in the washer with laundry detergent.
sentences.text_ko: 옷을 분류해서 세제 넣고 세탁기에 돌려요.

sentences.text: I make sure to change out the bedding too.
After switching the laundry to the dryer, I move on to the bathroom, which is my least favorite part of cleaning.
sentences.text_ko: 세탁물을 건조기로 옮기고 나면, 제일 싫어하는 욕실 청소로 넘어가요.

sentences.text: I grab my scrub brush and go to town scrubbing the sink, tub, and toilet, making sure to get rid of any soap scum or water stains.
sentences.text_ko: 솔 들고 세면대랑 욕조, 변기를 박박 닦아서 물때랑 비누 찌꺼기를 다 없애요.

sentences.text: Then, I mop the floors, take out the trash, and sort the recycling.
sentences.text_ko: 마무리로 바닥 닦고, 쓰레기 버리고, 분리수거도 해요.

sentences.text: To finish up, I fold clothes and put everything away.
Deep cleaning takes a while, but it's worth it.
sentences.text_ko: 대청소는 시간이 꽤 걸리지만, 그만한 가치가 있어요.

sentences.text: There's nothing better than relaxing in a spotless home after all that work.
sentences.text_ko: 다 끝내고 나서 깨끗한 집에서 쉬는 것만큼 좋은 게 없어요.

sentences.text: Once a week, I like to deep clean my house.
sentences.text_ko: 일주일에 한 번은 집을 제대로 청소하는 편이에요.

full_transcript: Day 9 Deep Cleaning Once a week, I like to deep clean my house. I start by decluttering. If I don't use it, it's got to go. I go through closets, drawers, and random junk that somehow piles up. Once I've cleared the clutter, I wipe down all surfaces, dust the shelves, and vacuum every corner of my house. I make sure to get the hard to reach spots I usually ignore, like behind the couch. I also do the dishes, wipe down appliances, and clean out the fridge. Then, I grab my broom and dustpan to sweep the floor and pick up any dust or crumbs before I mop. Next, I do a load of laundry. I sort my clothes and throw them in the washer with laundry detergent. I make sure to change out the bedding too. After switching the laundry to the dryer, I move on to the bathroom, which is my least favorite part of cleaning. I grab my scrub brush and go to town scrubbing the sink, tub, and toilet, making sure to get rid of any soap scum or water stains. Then, I mop the floors, take out the trash, and sort the recycling. To finish up, I fold clothes and put everything away. Deep cleaning takes a while, but it's worth it. There's nothing better than relaxing in a spotless home after all that work.
